CPI-AL is a Labour Bureau index with base 2019 (not NSO, 2024); WPI is compiled by the Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT with base 2011-12; and the GDP deflator (base 2022-23) comes from the NSO, not the Office of the Economic Adviser.
